import bpy
from collections import Counter
s=bpy.context.scene
c=Counter(o.name.split(' ')[0] for o in s.objects)
print(c)
cam=s.camera
print(cam.name, tuple(round(v,2) for v in cam.matrix_world.translation), [round(__import__('math').degrees(a),1) for a in cam.matrix_world.to_euler()], round(cam.data.lens,1))
d=cam.matrix_world.to_quaternion() @ __import__('mathutils').Vector((0,0,-1))
print('dir', tuple(round(v,2) for v in d))
for o in s.objects:
    if o.type=='LIGHT': print(o.name,o.data.type,tuple(round(v,1) for v in o.location),o.data.energy)
